response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals), timing_avgs AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY eventannotm) SELECT AVG(t.avg_ownership) AS mean_ownership, AVG(t.avg_ownership - o.avg_ownership) AS mean_above_average FROM timing_avgs AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.avg_ownership > o.avg_ownership;
